description: This file defines the IMiracastService interface and related enums and structures for Miracast service integration, including notification callbacks, control methods, and device parameters.

classes.name: IMiracastService
classes.description: Interface for Miracast service operations, including enabling/disabling, connection management, and notifications.

classes.name: IMiracastService::DeviceParameters
classes.description: Structure holding source and sink device network parameters.

classes.name: IMiracastService::Result
classes.description: Structure indicating success or failure message for operations.

classes.name: IMiracastService::INotification
classes.description: Interface for Miracast event callbacks such as connection requests and errors.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for Miracast events.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Enable or disable Miracast discovery feature.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Retrieve current enabled status of Miracast.

methods.name: AcceptClientConnection
methods.description: Accept or reject incoming client connection requests.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerState
methods.description: Update the state of a Miracast player for a client.

methods.name: SetP2PBackendDiscovery
methods.description: Enable or disable P2P backend discovery.
